lines.text: The herd took them back without a sound. The sentinel dropped its head.
The new deck. We walked them across. I held a halter that was not closed.
The calves are the only two that made it. I do not know what to do with that.
I filed Protective Extraction. I can renew it for six months. Or I can close the file.

choice.text: Close the file. Let them go home.
Renew it. They are safer in your care.

lines.text: ...Closed. Calf One. Calf Two. Go on. Go on.
Renewed. I am not sure that was the answer.
